title: Provider Kit gateway config
description: Puts an existing HTTP API, in any language, behind Provider Standard v1: manifest, x402 payment, job recovery and capacity. Run it with `provider-kit serve --config <file>`. Values written "env:NAME" are read from the environment variable NAME, in the fields that say so. The gateway holds no Stellar secret key.

baseUrl.description: The public HTTPS URL job paths are under, such as https://api.example.com/agent. http://localhost only with dev. May be "env:NAME".

payTo.description: The G... or C... address that receives payments: public, never a secret key. Use the agent wallet of your 8004 registration [I3]. May be "env:NAME".

facilitator.description: The x402 facilitator URL, such as https://x402.org/facilitator on testnet. May be "env:NAME".

facilitatorHeaders.description: Headers sent to the facilitator, for one that wants an API key. Values may be "env:NAME".

provider.description: Who you are, as the manifest shows it (§2.3).

agentId.description: Your Stellar 8004 agent id, after `provider-kit register`. May be "env:NAME".

rpcUrl.description: The Soroban RPC the gateway reads the chain with, to decide payment_uncertain jobs and time on-success jobs by ledger. Default: the public RPC on testnet; pubnet has none, so set yours. May be "env:NAME".

store.description: Where jobs are kept: a SQLite file path, relative to this config file (default ./jobs.sqlite), or "memory" for tests only. May be "env:NAME".

listen.description: Where `serve` listens. Default port 8787 on 0.0.0.0. The PORT environment variable overrides the port.

maxTimeoutSeconds.description: How long a signed payment is valid. Default 60.

settleTimeoutSeconds.description: How long a settlement may take before the job is payment_uncertain. Default maxTimeoutSeconds + 30.

retentionSeconds.description: How long finished jobs stay retrievable. Default 86400.

holdSeconds.description: How long create-job waits before answering 202. Default 30.

runQueuedJobs.description: Whether this process runs queued upfront jobs. Default true.

rateLimit.description: Per-caller limit on create-job (429). keyHeader names the header a trusted proxy sets to the caller's address.

dev.description: Allows http://localhost for baseUrl and the facilitator. Never in production.

description.description: What it does, when to use it, and its limits (§3.4).

price.description: USDC, as a decimal string such as "0.05".

timeoutSeconds.description: Longest the upstream call may take. Default: twice expectedDurationSeconds, or 600.

inputSchema.description: A JSON Schema object, or the path of a JSON file holding one, relative to this config file.

outputSchema.description: A JSON Schema object, or the path of a JSON file holding one.

capacity.description: What the upstream can take: calls at once, and how long a new job may wait (§5.8).

url.description: Where the input is POSTed as JSON. May be "env:NAME".

headers.description: Sent with every call, such as the upstream's own API key. Values may be "env:NAME".
